name: Primalist
passive: Magic Armor: +2 max Stress. Mana = INT × 10. You may spend Stress as Mana. Kits (both): Elemental Spear · Tide Focus. Free Weapon Swap between kits 1/your turn (second swap same turn costs 1 AP).
notes: Spear: pick element 1/turn in sandbox. Tide: Slow enemy / Cleanse ally. Core: Shove Push 3/4/5; Steel CLEANSE 3/4/6.
